name: Q0302-C171 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Lyman-break galaxy Q0302-C171, seen by Hubble.
label: q0302c171-hubble
story: Somewhere among the faint specks here is Q0302-C171, a Lyman-break galaxy from a small, carefully studied sample whose gas motions were mapped from the ground. Hubble added sharp images to test whether the tangled motions in such galaxies come from ongoing mergers.

claims.text: Q0302-C171 is a Lyman-break galaxy in the LSD sample at the pointing position
The LSD project mapped the galaxies' gas with spatially resolved spectroscopy
Hubble imaging was used to test whether complex velocity fields come from ongoing mergers
